sections.title: Use the toolbar controls
sections.excerpt: Use the toolbar controls | The top bar has undo, redo, and close; the side panel has search, a locale selector when multiple languages exist, and a funnel-insights toggle. Shortcuts: Ctrl+Z undo, Ctrl+Shift+Z redo, Ctrl+F search.

sections.title: Read the flow structure
sections.excerpt: Read the flow structure | The canvas shows every screen as a node and every transition as an edge. Drag to arrange, click to select, and double-click a node to open the Screen Editor; the flow runs left to right.

sections.title: Identify the launch screen
sections.excerpt: Identify the launch screen | The first screen carries a First screen label on its left. The launch screen is where every visitor enters; only one can be the launch screen and it cannot have incoming connections.

sections.title: Navigate the canvas
sections.excerpt: Navigate the canvas | Scroll to zoom, hold space and drag to pan, and use the minimap in the corner for the full layout. Click to select a screen; Ctrl+click to multi-select.
